summary: Iter 61 Perplexity Sonar integration into Medical News Sentinel + Morning Briefing verified end-to-end. Backend 9/9 pytest passed (test_iter61_perplexity_news.py); founder /api/news/feed returns 200 fast (<8s) with live=true, engine 'Perplexity Sonar · sonar-pro', 6 general items all live-* with http URLs, no [1] or ** markers, and shaped correctly; fresh dev-bypass user got immediate live cache hit (warm general:sk:EU) with 6 live items and no crash; ?force=true 200; unauth 401; /news/{id}/hunt 200 with waitlist_item for a live item having hunt_city and 404 unknown; /news/tech-tracker 200; /agent/briefing (founder, force+cached) 200 with briefing text + 3 news + news_engine 'Perplexity Sonar · sonar-pro'; /agent/search regression 200 with live_search=true and citations. Frontend web (390x844): founder-bypass-btn login → /medical-news shows testID news-live-badge 'LIVE · Perplexity Sonar · sonar-pro · updated 04:39 PM · refreshing…', 6 news-source-<news_id> underlined links, 1 news-hunt-* (only cards with 🏥 city), 6 news-jarvis-* consult buttons, disclaimer mentions Perplexity Sonar; /jarvis shows jv-news card with header '🌐 HEALTH NEWS TODAY · LIVE · Perplexity Sonar · sonar-pro', rows jv-news-0..2 with title/summary/source/url, jv-mode-sonar chip present, briefing text renders. Fresh UI user (bypass-toggle/email/submit) → /medical-news renders instantly with LIVE badge + live cards, no blank/hang. Observation (non-blocker): founder personalized array = 0 in current cache so 'FOR YOU (0)' shows empty-state message and no MATCHES YOUR VAULT badge appears — matches spec fallback; general feed content appears in Czech (cache likely populated by a cs user) even though founder lang=en per playbook — worth confirming personal cache is running.

integration_issues.issue: FOR YOU (0) shown for the founder — personal Sonar cache appears empty so no MATCHES YOUR VAULT badge / jarvis_alert card is rendered. Backend response shape is correct (empty personalized array). Confirm _user_focus() actually returns focus terms and that the personal cache key is being refreshed.

General live items display in Czech even though founder language=en per playbook (screenshot: 'Kmenové buňky přidané k bypassu…', 'V časné klinické studii…'). Cache key uses (lang,country) so a Czech user hitting general:en:SG shouldn't overwrite en output — verify the cache was actually populated for en and that the founder's user.language is 'en' in DB.

react_native_issues.issue: Console spam on web: deprecated 'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props (use boxShadow / textShadow) and props.pointerEvents (use style.pointerEvents). Not blocking but should be migrated for RN 0.75+ / Expo SDK 51+.

action_items: Verify founder personalized live cache is being written (key personal:<uid>:<focus_hash>) — currently returning 0 personalized items even though the playbook says warm caches exist. Possibly _user_focus() returns [] for the founder in this fork (no waitlist / jarvis_actions / disease/surgery events).

Investigate general feed items rendering in Czech for founder (lang=en). Confirm user.language in db.users for guardian.angel.core@proton.me and check whether medical_news_live docs for general:en:SG actually contain English text.
Migrate deprecated RN style props (shadow*, textShadow*, props.pointerEvents) — noisy console warnings on every screen render.
critical_code_review_comments: perplexity.py sonar() handles 429 with a single 2.5s retry — reasonable, but after that it returns None and callers back off for 3 minutes (LIVE_BACKOFF). Good.
routes/news.py _cached_live returns stale items + pending=true when the cache is stale, and never blocks the response — correct implementation of the 'response never waits for Sonar' requirement.
routes/agent.py _live_health_news caches empty results ONLY when items>0 — good, avoids sticky empty briefing news.
seed_data_creation: One fresh dev-bypass user created per run (iter61-fresh-<uuid>@example.com, iter61-ui-<uuid>@example.com) — harmless test users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Perplexity API key valid; warm caches for general:en:SG, general:sk:EU exist. If retesting, avoid pounding ?force=true (rate-limit sensitive). Founder personalized may still be empty until backend seeds waitlist/jarvis_actions or user_focus returns tags.
